about_the_game:
You follow the story of Poba, a girl trying to buy a house with her sister within the city of paphollana, after their old one burned down. To achieve this, the two have decided to reopen their father's old cafe at the edge of the city.

In this game, you will be tasked with cooking for customers which will seat themselves in your establishment, renovating their bar to become the talk of the town, and eventually buy a house for the protagonist to finally live in!


Snacks, Ice Cream, Meats, Pies and Drinks are only some of the meals you can serve over the course of your career. Some only require you to place food on top of a tray, others will require you to pour drinks, wait for them to finish cooking, and so on... the harder it is to prepare a dish, the more money its worth!


At the end of each day you will be granted an amount of experience based on how well you performed during the day. Leveling up your cafe will unlock new clients and upgrades, or even allow you to renovate your bar, permanently increasing the number of customers that can come in each day and unlocking new designs for your establishment.

Among said upgrades are new types of food items for your menu and upgrades for them which increases their sell price while also makes clients' orders much more complicated.

Optionally, after each shift, you may view cutscenes you've unlocked during the course of your playtrough, where you can see Poba's discussions, adventures and misadventures when interacting with the other people around the city of Paphollana.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6400 CPU @ 2.70GHz 2.70 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTS 450 (1 GB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game will be tested on lower end devices, which might result in lower system requirements
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6400 CPU @ 2.70GHz 2.70 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950M (2 GB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Bar at the Edge of Papillon is a simple but busy cafe sim where you serve a plethora of unique clients while using your earnings to upgrade your cafe and unlock new kinds of meals, turning from a run down establishment to the talk of the town.
